subject.title: feat(control-ui): show compaction savings and run time

question: After the timestamp defect and proof gap are resolved, should Control UI permanently expose both compaction savings and active-run elapsed time in the chat transcript?
rationale: The linked issue remains marked as needing a product decision, and this feature adds persistent user-visible chat presentation rather than repairing an established contract.

options.title: Adopt both indicators
options.body: Land both observability indicators after the timer contract, real behavior proof, and required checks are corrected.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Keep only the compaction metric or elapsed timer if maintainers want less persistent chat UI.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the feature issue and PR if these metrics should remain in secondary diagnostics rather than the transcript.

recommendation.title: Adopt both indicators
recommendation.body: Land both observability indicators after the timer contract, real behavior proof, and required checks are corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior adjacent run-state ownership and current involvement make them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
